name: ARACNe3
method_summary: ARACNe reconstructs an undirected gene association network from expression data using mutual information and data processing inequality pruning to remove indirect dependencies. The ARACNe3 implementation used here strengthens the base method with adaptive partitioning and consensus over subsampled subnetworks.

progress.note: Progress percent is based on completed subnetworks when adaptive=false; in adaptive mode total iterations are unknown and only coarse phase updates are reported.

alpha.description: Alpha cutoff used in the first pruning step (FDR/FWER/FPR mode).

x.description: Iteration control parameter: number of subnetworks (adaptive=false) or target occupancy threshold (adaptive=true).

adaptive.description: If true, x is interpreted as minimum targets per regulator for adaptive stopping.

min_subnets.description: Minimum number of subnetworks required before adaptive stopping can terminate.

method.description: Statistical criterion used in alpha pruning.

subsample.description: Fraction of samples used in each subnetwork generation.

no_alpha.description: If true, skip alpha-based pruning step.

no_maxent.description: If true, skip Maximum Entropy pruning step.

seed.description: Optional random seed for deterministic subnet sampling.
